beats.title: Party heads to warehouses near the water wheel
beats.summary: The group decides to go to the last few known warehouses located near the water wheel, an area known to house Goblins, Hobgoblins and Bugbears, with the BBQ about 12 hours away. Bonogo leads through the tunnels with Ephanna's Sprite helping.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-10:202289dc3d5e:span:202289dc3d5e:28-28
anchor_quotes: The group decides to go to the last few known warehouses located near the water wheel.
Bonogo takes the lead through the tunnels again with Ephanna’s Sprite helping.

beats.title: Trap darts and a trap door with music above
beats.summary: The first steps reveal a trap that shoots darts into Bonogo. Down the tunnel the group spots an old dusty ladder leading to another trap door; Ephanna hears rhythmic thumping that may be music, and Stafl finds tracks continuing down the tunnel, becoming convinced the thumping is music from above.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-10:202289dc3d5e:span:202289dc3d5e:30-30
anchor_quotes: The first steps reveal a trap that shoots darts into Bonogo.
Down the tunnel the group spots an old dusty ladder leading up to another trap door.
Stafl discovers tracks continuing down the tunnel, and is even more convinced the thumping is music from above.

beats.title: Grit and Grime party discovered
beats.summary: Lifting the trapdoor reveals a huge party at the Grit and Grime, a warehouse turned club for Goblins, Hobgoblins and Bugbears. The party decides to continue on.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-10:202289dc3d5e:span:202289dc3d5e:32-32
anchor_quotes: When the trapdoor is lifted they discover a huge party happening at the Grit and Grime, a warehouse turned club for Goblins, Hobgoblins and Bugbears.
The party decides to continue on.

beats.title: Bonogo trapped by blocks and goo
beats.summary: Another trap triggers, trapping Bonogo between two massive blocks with goo/gas creeping up from broken bottles. Baergrom, Caelynn and Karsemine try to lift the first block, barely moving it even with a crowbar, but lift it enough for Caelynn to freeze the noxious mixture while Bonogo hoists himself up and chips at the block.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-10:202289dc3d5e:span:202289dc3d5e:34-34
anchor_quotes: Almost immediately another trap is triggered, this time trapping Bonogo between two massive blocks and a goo/gas begins to creep up from broken bottles on the ground.
They manage to lift it enough for Caelynn to freeze the noxious mixture at the bottom while Bonogo hoists himself up and begins to chip away at the block.

beats.title: Stafl recruits the Bugbear Thraxx
beats.summary: Stafl heads back to the party seeking a Bugbear, interrupts the party and must explain himself to the owner. Quick thinking and fast talking gain the party a new ally: a massive Bugbear named Thraxx.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-10:202289dc3d5e:span:202289dc3d5e:36-36
anchor_quotes: Stafl heads back to the party in search of a Bugbear.
Some quick thinking and fast talking and the party now has a new ally: a massive Bugbear named Thraxx.

beats.title: Block shattered; approach to the last warehouse
beats.summary: Using a portable battering ram, Thraxx and Baergrom shatter the block and free Bonogo, clearing a straight shot through the tunnel to the last warehouse. Caelynn fills Thraxx in on the quest details en route to the last ladder and trap door; Bonogo sneaks a look and sees another chilled warehouse with rows of meat and Cultists, Meat Mounds, and winged Abhorrent Meat Wings.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-10:202289dc3d5e:span:202289dc3d5e:38-38
anchor_quotes: With the use of a portable battering ram Thraxx and Baergrom are able to shatter the block and free Bonogo.
Now it's a straight shot to the last warehouse through this tunnel.
Another chilled warehouse with rows of meat and Cultists, Meat Mounds, and other creatures with wings: Abhorrent Meat Wings.

beats.title: Opening round of the meat monster battle
beats.summary: Bonogo immediately kills two Cultists; Ephanna uses magic and Baergrom uses oil and a torch; Stafl casts Sleep on another Cultist while Caelynn casts Thunderwave; Karsemine dashes about with Zephyr Strike throwing alcohol and attacking as she passes; Thraxx punches winged creatures to death with his mechanical arm.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-10:202289dc3d5e:span:202289dc3d5e:40-40
anchor_quotes: Bonogo immediately kills two Cultists.
Ephanna uses magic and Baergrom uses oil and a torch.
Stafl casts Sleep on another Cultist while Caelynn casts Thunderwave.
And Thraxx uses his massive mechanical arm to punch winged creatures to death.

beats.title: Charm effects turn the party against itself
beats.summary: The party pushes the attack; Caelynn is knocked unconscious and Stafl is Charmed. Baergrom uses a health potion on Caelynn and Karsemine kills another Cultist. Then Bonogo, Baergrom and Karsemine all become Charmed and the Sprite is killed: Baergrom attacks Stafl, Karsemine attacks Thraxx, and Bonogo again knocks Caelynn unconscious while Thraxx knocks Karsemine unconscious. Ephanna finally helps break the Charm on the group.
